```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)

bank <- read_delim("data/train.csv", delim = ";") |>
  select(y, age, balance, campaign, housing, contact, poutcome) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
bank
```

```{r}
# Subscription counts
bank |>
  count(y) |>
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
```

Response is not balanced. Relevant for choosing metric and splitting data.

```{r}
# Split data 70/30, keeping same proportion of "yes" in each set
set.seed(558)
bank_split <- initial_split(bank, prop = 0.7, strata = y)
bank_train <- training(bank_split)
bank_test <- testing(bank_split)
bank_split

# 5 CV folds from training data
bank_folds <- vfold_cv(bank_train, v = 5)
```

```{r}
# Recipe: y predicted by all 6 predictors
bank_rec <- recipe(y ~ ., data = bank_train)
bank_rec
```

```{r}
# Metrics to evaluate models: log loss and accuracy
bank_metrics <- metric_set(mn_log_loss, accuracy)
```



```{r}
# Fit a tree with a given cost_complexity, return log loss
tree_train_loss <- function(cp) {
  tree_spec <- decision_tree(cost_complexity = cp) |>
    set_engine("rpart") |>
    set_mode("classification")

  tree_fit <- workflow() |>
    add_recipe(bank_rec) |>
    add_model(tree_spec) |>
    fit(bank_train)

  predict(tree_fit, bank_train, type = "prob") |>
    bind_cols(bank_train) |>
    mn_log_loss(truth = y, .pred_no) |>
    mutate(cost_complexity = cp)
}
```

```{r}
# Try multiple cost_complexity values and combine
cp_values <- c(0.1, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001, 0.00001)
tree_results <- lapply(cp_values, tree_train_loss) |>
  bind_rows()
tree_results

# Plot log loss 
ggplot(tree_results, aes(x = factor(cost_complexity), y = .estimate)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "cost_complexity", y = "Log loss")
```

```{r}
# Pick lowest log loss
tree_best <- tree_results |>
  filter(.estimate == min(.estimate))
tree_best
```
